title: Felt & Rain
description: Warm felt-piano chords drift over a shuffled, broken UK 2-step beat — intimate and nostalgic, with lo-fi crackle and a hazy bittersweet glow. It blooms early into a swung garage-house groove with sub and skipping hats, then deconstructs into a wet, dreamier piano outro.
code:
setcpm(128/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3,ab3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.3).gain(0.62)
      .lpf("<700 900>/4").crush(11),
    s("hh*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.4).swingBy(0.16, 8).hpf(6000).gain(0.35)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(1.05),
    s("hh*4").bank("LinnDrum").swingBy(0.18, 8).gain(0.42).coarse(2),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3,ab3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.34).gain(0.6)
      .lpf("<900 1300 1100 1600>/4").crush(11)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(1.1),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5).room(0.2),
    s("hh*4").bank("LinnDrum").swingBy(0.2, 8).gain(0.45).coarse(2)
      .every(4, x => x.ply("<1 1 2 3>")),
    s("oh(3,8,2)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.34).hpf(4000),
    note("<c1 ab0 bb0 g0>").s("jvbass").gain(0.8).lpf("<400 600>/2").shape(0.2),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3,ab3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.36).gain(0.6)
      .lpf("<1400 2000 1700 2400>/4").crush(12)
      .off(0.1875, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.42))
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3,ab3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.55).gain(0.6)
      .delay(".4:.1875:.5").lpf("<1100 1500>/4").crush(10)
      .off(0.1875, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.4)),
    note("<c1 ab0 bb0 g0>").s("jvbass").gain(0.7).lpf(420).shape(0.18)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(1.12),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.52).room(0.25),
    s("hh*4").bank("LinnDrum").swingBy(0.2, 8).gain(0.46).coarse(2)
      .every(8, x => x.ply("<2 3>")),
    s("oh(5,8,2)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.36).hpf(4200),
    s("rim(3,8)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.3).pan(0.7),
    note("<c1 ab0 bb0 g0>").s("jvbass").gain(0.82).lpf("<500 700 600 900>/4").shape(0.22),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3,ab3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.4).gain(0.6)
      .delay(".35:.1875:.4").lpf("<2200 2800 2400 3200>/4").crush(12)
      .off(0.1875, x => x.add(note("<12 7>")).gain(0.42))
      .every(8, x => x.rev())
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3,ab3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.6).gain(0.6)
      .delay(".5:.25:.55").lpf("<800 1100>/4").crush(9)
      .off(0.1875, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.38)),
    s("hh*4").bank("LinnDrum").swingBy(0.18, 8).gain(0.3).hpf(7000).degradeBy(0.4)
  )]
)
